selection_reasoning: I selected 10 tasks that form a coherent exploration and mining sequence in a custom-built scene. The structure creates a multi-hop dependency where the player must navigate through distinct zones. The scene is designed as a path: the player starts near a sandstone structure, mines through it to access a cobblestone area, which leads to a greenhouse/garden zone containing glass, crops, and decorative items. The 'find' tasks require navigating past mining obstacles or through areas unlocked by earlier mining. The dependency chain creates meaningful progression: mining sandstone reveals a path to cobblestone, mining cobblestone opens access to an enclosed garden area with wheat, beetroots, and the potted poppy. The stained glass must be mined to enter a decorated room containing the banner, bed-area items, and the dark oak fence. Finding the lilac and cyan terracotta require traversing earlier zones.

edges.reason: Cobblestone wall is behind the sandstone barrier; must mine sandstone to reach it
Cyan terracotta floor is in the corridor revealed after mining sandstone wall
Wheat farm is in the enclosed garden area accessible only after removing cobblestone wall
Beetroot crops are planted in the garden behind the cobblestone barrier
Lilac bush is planted in the garden area behind the cobblestone wall
Potted poppy is on a shelf inside the garden room behind cobblestone
Stained glass window separates garden from the decorated display room
Magenta banner hangs inside the display room accessed by breaking the glass partition
Dark oak fence is used as railing inside the display room behind the glass wall

milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most to verify the sandstone barrier wall at z=3 has been partially broken (creating passage). The barrier is a 3x3 wall of regular sandstone at positions [1,1,3] to [3,3,3]. Originally 9 blocks; max_count=8 means at least 1 was removed. This is preferred over inventory_has because we want to verify the actual barrier was broken for passage, and the scene uses smooth_sandstone for the floor to prevent exploits.

Uses position_near_with_facing to verify the player has reached the cyan terracotta floor area in room 2 (z=7-10). The terracotta is the floor at y=0. Using facing_tolerance=180 (no facing requirement) since the player walks ON the terracotta — proximity alone confirms they found it. The player must have mined through the sandstone barrier to reach this area (distance from spawn ~7 blocks, exceeding max_distance=5).

Uses count_in_box_at_most to verify the cobblestone barrier wall at z=10 has been partially broken (creating passage). The barrier is a 3x3 wall of cobblestone at positions [1,1,10] to [3,3,10]. Originally 9 blocks; max_count=8 means at least 1 was removed. This is preferred over inventory_has because the room side walls are stone (different block) and we want to verify the actual barrier was broken for passage.

Uses inventory_has because breaking fully grown wheat (age=7) drops wheat items into the player's inventory. The wheat crop is in the garden room at (~1, ~2, ~12). There is only one wheat block in the scene and no other source of wheat items, making inventory_has unambiguous.

Uses position_near_with_facing to verify the player has navigated into the garden and is facing the beetroots crop at (~2, ~2, ~12). The beetroots are at the player's chest/eye level (y=2, player eye at ~y=2.6), so a 60-degree facing tolerance accommodates the slight downward look needed.

Uses position_near_with_facing to verify the player has navigated into the garden and is facing the lilac flower at (~3, ~1, ~13). The lilac lower half is at y=1 (player body level), easily visible when facing that direction. 60-degree tolerance is generous enough for natural observation.

Uses inventory_has because breaking a potted_poppy drops a poppy and a flower_pot into the player's inventory. Checking for poppy confirms the potted plant was broken. There is no other source of poppy items in the scene. The potted poppy is at (~1, ~2, ~14) in the garden.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because light gray stained glass does NOT drop items when broken without Silk Touch. Cannot use inventory_has. The partition is a 3x3 wall at z=17 spanning [1,1,17] to [3,3,17]. Originally 9 blocks; max_count=8 means at least 1 was broken to create passage into the display room.

Uses position_near_with_facing to verify the player has entered the display room and is facing the magenta wall banner at (~2, ~2, ~19). The banner is attached to the back wall (z=20) facing north. Max_distance reduced to 2 to require the player to actually be inside the display room (z>=18) rather than observing through the transparent glass from the garden side, enforcing the dependency on breaking the glass partition.

Uses position_near_with_facing to verify the player is near and facing the dark oak fence railing at the display room entrance. The fence spans x=1-3 at y=1, z=18. Max_distance reduced to 2 to require the player to actually be at or past the glass partition (z>=17), enforcing the dependency on breaking through it. 60-degree tolerance accommodates the downward look to floor-level fence.

scene_description: A linear 4-room corridor structure (5 blocks wide, 21 blocks deep) where the player progresses through physical barriers. Room 1: smooth sandstone floor with sandstone walls, barrier wall of regular sandstone at z=3. Room 2: cyan terracotta floor with stone walls, cobblestone barrier at z=10. Room 3: grass floor garden with oak plank walls containing wheat, beetroots, lilac, and potted poppy, with a light gray stained glass partition at z=17. Room 4: dark oak display room with magenta wall banner and dark oak fence railing.
task_text: Navigate through a series of rooms by mining barriers. Start by mining the sandstone wall ahead, then mine the cobblestone wall behind it. In the garden, harvest wheat, find the beetroots, lilac, and potted poppy. Finally, break through the stained glass partition to find the magenta banner and dark oak fence in the display room.
design_notes: Final version incorporating all team feedback. Key design decisions: (1) smooth_sandstone floor in Room 1 prevents mining floor to satisfy sandstone barrier milestone. (2) Stone side walls in Room 2 prevent mining walls to satisfy cobblestone barrier milestone. (3) magenta_wall_banner[facing=north] at z=19 correctly attaches to back wall at z=20 and faces the approaching player. (4) Explicit air-clearing commands for each room interior ensure clean passages. (5) Back wall at z=0 encloses the starting area. (6) Command ordering: enclosures built first, interiors cleared, barriers placed, then decorative items/crops placed last to avoid being overwritten. Player spawns at approximately (~2, ~1, ~1) facing +Z direction.
